item.title: Analisis Dampak Bullying Terhadap Interaksi Sosial Santri di Pondok Pesantren Modern Daar El- Falaah Mandalawangi

item.title: Penerapan Teknik Cognitive Restructuring dalam Layanan Bimbingan Karir untuk Meningkatkan Perencanaan Karir Siswa
item.description: Immaturity in students' career planning is often not caused by a lack of information, but rather by mental barriers in the form of irrational thought patterns and cognitive distortions.
